responsibility: Declares the command-line options accepted by the M32R backend and the target variables they control. Through GCC’s option-description format it introduces CPU-selection flags, loop-alignment and issue-rate tuning, branch-cost and debug toggles, cache-flush configuration, and the enumerated -mmodel and -msdata settings, while tying them to the enums from m32r-opts.h so the rest of the backend can query normalized target state.
same_name_distinction: Option-definition file for the M32R backend: unlike m32r.cc it does not implement target behavior, unlike m32r.h it does not define the target's ABI/layout macro configuration, and unlike m32r.md it does not describe RTL instructions or scheduling; instead it is the declarative source of M32R-specific command-line switches and the variables/enums that carry those selections into the backend.
